Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7.
Then, pick 1 of the following effects to apply until the start of your next turn, where X is equal to your fury level.

options.name: Vigour of the Ur-Salamander
options.text: Add X" to this unit's Move characteristic.

options.name: Fiery Determination
options.text: Add X to this unit's control score.

options.name: Kyndlewrath
options.text: Add X to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Emberteeth.
